The hedge fund held 147,300 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $3.93B, down from 150,900 at the end of the previous reported quarter. (NYSE:HTA) has declined 7.25% since December 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 7.25% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Apple In (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 75,597 shares in the quarter, for a total of 149,944 shares, and has risen its stake in Tesla In (Prn).
